items.question: Which claim about Brahmā’s inclusion and the remainder’s treatment does this Śrīvidyā line assert by naming lineage, Brahmā-also, Sarveśvaryambā, and remainder as before?

Brahmā is included together with the goddess named
Remainder is joined and handled by the prior procedure
items.inference: The verse states that even Brahmā is counted within this invocation to Sarveśvaryambā and that the remaining items follow the same procedure as before.
